title: Practice 7: Which prefix? — the whole table, as practice

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Tom ran away with the money.
exercises.why: **сбежал** — past tense (masculine) of сбежать: perfective (imperfective partner: сбегать).  Prefix **с-, со-**: movement downwards (с + gen.; на + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

exercises.q: A wasp flew into Tom's mouth.
exercises.why: **залетела** — past tense (feminine) of залететь: perfective (imperfective partner: залетать).  Prefix **за-**: movement behind an object; stopping off on the way (в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

**придёт** — future tense (3rd person singular) of прийти: perfective (imperfective partner: приходить).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: Where does the bus leave from?
exercises.why: **отходит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of отходить: imperfective (perfective partner: отойти).  Prefix **от-, ото-**: withdrawal a short distance away (от + gen).

exercises.q: John came running into the room.
exercises.why: **вбежал** — past tense (masculine) of вбежать: perfective (imperfective partner: вбегать).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: A mouse came into the room.
exercises.why: **вбежала** — past tense (feminine) of вбежать: perfective (imperfective partner: вбегать).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).
**отвезу** — future tense (1st person singular) of отвезти: perfective (imperfective partner: отвозить).  Prefix **от-, ото-**: withdrawal a short distance away (от + gen).
**сбежал** — past tense (masculine) of сбежать: perfective (imperfective partner: сбегать).  Prefix **с-, со-**: movement downwards (с + gen.; на + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

**выйдем** — future tense (1st person plural) of выйти: perfective (imperfective partner: выходить).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

**зайдём** — future tense (1st person plural) of зайти: perfective (imperfective partner: заходить).  Prefix **за-**: movement behind an object; stopping off on the way (в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

exercises.q: He was taken off on a stretcher.
exercises.why: **унесли** — past tense (plural) of унести: perfective (imperfective partner: уносить).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: A fly got into the apartment.
exercises.why: **залетела** — past tense (feminine) of залететь: perfective (imperfective partner: залетать).  Prefix **за-**: movement behind an object; stopping off on the way (в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).
**вносите** — present tense (2nd person plural) of вносить: imperfective (perfective partner: внести).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

**приду** — future tense (1st person singular) of прийти: perfective (imperfective partner: приходить).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: The couch won't fit in the elevator.
exercises.why: **влезет** — future tense (3rd person singular) of влезть: perfective (imperfective partner: влезать).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).
**взбежала** — past tense (feminine) of взбежать: perfective (imperfective partner: взбегать).  Prefix **вз-, взо-, воз-, вс-, вос-**: movement upwards (в / на + acc).

**заеду** — future tense (1st person singular) of заехать: perfective (imperfective partner: заезжать).  Prefix **за-**: movement behind an object; stopping off on the way (в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

**переплыли** — past tense (plural) of переплыть: perfective (imperfective partner: переплывать).  Prefix **пере-**: movement across, from one point to another; through (через + acc.; without preposition + acc).

exercises.q: Is this the right way to the museum?
exercises.why: **доедем** — future tense (1st person plural) of доехать: perfective (imperfective partner: доезжать).  Prefix **до-**: reaching a limit or destination (до + gen).
**доводите** — present tense (2nd person plural) of доводить: imperfective (perfective partner: довести).  Prefix **до-**: reaching a limit or destination (до + gen).
